test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**labouring**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the harsh realities faced by children working in various fields.
 
• The appropriate verb should describe children performing physical work or tasks, which fits the context of domestic work and other menial jobs.
 
• **"Labouring" **fits well as it refers to engaging in physical work or toil, which aligns with the types of work described in the passage.
 
• Other options like "cheating," "revolting," and "excelling" do not match the context of physical work in menial jobs.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Cheating" **refers to dishonesty, which does not fit the context of children doing physical labor.
 
• **"Revolting"** refers to something that causes disgust or repulsion, which does not describe the act of working in menial jobs.
 
• **"Excelling"** refers to performing well or succeeding, which contrasts with the context of children doing physical labor out of necessity.
